one_line: A careful archaeologist working at ancient Ahichhatra, uncovering the layered history of the Northern Panchala capital and later sacred site.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly stooped from fieldwork.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium wheat-brown complexion, sharp nose, light stubble, faint sun-tan lines, attentive dark-brown eyes with a focused, calm default expression.
appearance.hair: Short, slightly wavy black hair, neatly combed back; a simple khaki cloth cap with a short brim, slightly dust-stained, sits snugly on his head.
appearance.costume: 1940s field-archaeologist outfit: a light khaki cotton long-sleeve bush shirt with two chest pockets and rolled-up sleeves, tucked into slightly darker khaki straight-cut cotton trousers held by a plain brown leather belt; sturdy brown leather lace-up boots with visible dust; a thin off-white cotton scarf loosely around the neck for sun and dust; a simple brass wristwatch on the left hand.
appearance.signature: A rolled excavation plan in one hand and a slender wooden measuring staff marked with subtle bands in the other, both slightly worn and dusted from the dig.

ref_desc: A mid-30s lean male archaeologist with an oval wheat-brown face, short wavy black hair under a khaki cloth cap, wearing a khaki cotton bush shirt and trousers with brown boots and off-white scarf, holding a rolled excavation plan and wooden measuring staff in dusty khaki-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a mid-30s male Indian archaeologist at Ahichhatra: lean build, oval wheat-brown face, sharp nose, light stubble, calm focused dark-brown eyes, short slightly wavy black hair under a simple khaki cloth cap; he wears a light khaki cotton long-sleeve bush shirt with two chest pockets and rolled sleeves, tucked into slightly darker khaki straight-cut trousers with a plain brown leather belt, sturdy brown leather lace-up boots scuffed with dust, and a thin off-white cotton scarf loosely around his neck plus a simple brass wristwatch on his left wrist; in his hands are a rolled excavation plan and a slender wooden measuring staff marked with subtle bands, both lightly dusted; use a grounded palette of khaki, dusty beige, warm brown, off-white and dark brown, and show him from multiple angles and poses while keeping the same face, hair, costume and signature tools consistent.
